claims.explanation: The claim states that Eastmere received 115 generators on 12 March 2025. However, the source S1 states that exactly 65 generators arrived on that date and that there were no other deliveries that day, which contradicts the claim.
claims.missing: Any evidence that Eastmere received more than 65 generators on 12 March 2025 or on any other date around that time.
